## Context / Problem
17 modules under `tests/interfaces/` (16 pairs: 1 in `contracts/`, 6 in `facades/`, 6 in `lifecycle/`, 1 in `store/`, 2 at the directory root) and `tests/integration/` (1 pair, `test_s3_doctor.py`) have a `<name>_heldout.py` twin. Once both oracles have been reviewed the split only doubles module count, duplicates identical helper definitions, and makes every rename touch two files. Across these 17 pairs no test-function name collides; 5 pairs carry helper definitions with differing bodies and every other colliding definition is identical. The pair list with per-pair rename sets, filtered from enumeration (2) of the test-suite epic's first comment, is itemised in this ticket's first comment. Cites re-measured on origin/main 7927904a0: the 17 pairs, their per-directory split, the absence of any colliding test name, and the 5 differing-definition pairs were each re-counted from `git ls-files` and an AST diff of every pair, not sampled. The per-directory split verified exactly as stated, as did both unpaired modules named in Scope.

## Approach
Directories: `tests/interfaces/` and `tests/integration/` — 17 pairs; 6 definition renames spread over 5 pairs — `_plant_blob`/`_run_cli` (test_bridge_status), `_create_data` (test_detected_by), `_make` (test_ac_checkbox_precheck), `_commit_ref` (test_close_gate_subtree), `_cli` (test_metrics_cli). For each pair: `cat` the held-out module into the base under a `# ── held-out oracles (merged from <name>_heldout.py) ──` divider; keep the base module docstring and append the held-out docstring's "what it proves" paragraph; dedupe identical definitions (`pytestmark` counts here — keep the base copy); rename differing definitions and repoint their callers; `git rm` the held-out file. Rename rule: suffix the HELD-OUT definition `_heldout` (e.g. `_load_heldout`) and repoint its callers; keep the base copy of identical definitions. `tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_close_gate_subtree.py` cites bug ferric-jet-scorpion in its docstring; that docstring stays the base docstring. No test body changes.

## Scope
In scope: the 17 base modules under `tests/interfaces/` and `tests/integration/` named in the first comment and their 17 `_heldout` twins. Out of scope: the `tests/unit/` pairs (S1, S2), `tests/scripts/` (S4), the 78 unpaired held-out renames (S5) — including `tests/interfaces/facades/test_reconciler_last_pass_heldout.py` and `tests/interfaces/store/test_repair_pause_ownership_heldout.py`, which have no base twin in this directory — every file under `src/`, and any test body change.

## Testing
Per pair: `pytest --collect-only -q <base> <heldout>` before and `pytest --collect-only -q <base>` after — counts equal (both recorded on this ticket); `pytest <base>` green (the `tests/integration/test_s3_doctor.py` pair runs under `-m integration`). `make test` green.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Zero paired twins remain in these directories: for each of the 17 pairs `git ls-files <base>_heldout.py` prints nothing (the unpaired `_heldout` modules in these directories are untouched here and renamed in S5).
- [ ] Per-pair node counts reconcile: each merged base collects exactly the sum of the two prior counts, from the before/after `pytest --collect-only -q` runs recorded on this ticket.
- [ ] `python scripts/check_mechanism_delta.py --check` **exits 0** — this story introduces no unadmitted mechanism. **AMENDED 2026-10-31 — the original `shows new=0` form is unmeetable.** `new=N` counts marker-ADMITTED entries as well as unadmitted ones, so a clean tree at current main already reports a nonzero `new` and exits 0. No implementation of this story could drive that counter to 0, so the criterion would fail at the end regardless of the work. Exit 0 is the gate's real pass signal, which is the property this AC means to assert. Root cause filed as bug `6f24-3d47-b251-4905`, now fixed in `AGENTS.md` and `rebar explain plan`. No autouse fixture lives in these pairs.
- [ ] `make verify` green, AND the integration pair is proven separately: `pytest tests/integration/test_s3_doctor.py -m ""` green. `make verify` runs `make test`, which selects `not integration and not external`, so it never collects `tests/integration/test_s3_doctor.py`; without this explicit command the merge of that pair would land unproven.
